title: Hunts FH-038: Connect approved store items

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 4, Merchandise. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Deep link approved SKU and preserve checkout, stock, receipts and fulfillment. Apply entitlement only if offer requires it. Done when: Order retry never duplicates benefit, shipping remains store-owned and refunded SKU revokes unused benefit. Requires: FH-035, FH-037. Owner role: Commerce.
